content:
Although the very end of 2026 promised to be much calmer in terms of game releases following the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI, December will be another packed month with plenty of games and expansions launching on PC and consoles. However, Team Cherry decided there was still room for one more highly anticipated release, as the Hollow Knight: Silksong free Sea of Sorrow expansion will launch in two weeks, on December 11.
"Voyage above and beneath a vast forgotten sea in Hollow Knight: Silksong's first giant expansion, releasing free for all players on December 11, 2026," reads the official description of the expansion's launch trailer, which confirmed its release date on PC, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, Nintendo Switch 2, and Nintendo Switch.
Unfortunately, not much else is known about the expansion for one of the best games released in 2025, but judging from the trailer, its additions will be substantial, as is tradition for Team Cherry, as the studio released four free expansions for the first entry in the series, which added well over 15 hours of content.
Although it is nice to learn that Team Cherry kept its promise, as Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow was scheduled for a 2026 release, what's more interesting to see is how the studio is not shying away from taking on directly one of the biggest releases of the year that is not called Grand Theft Auto VI: Path of Exile 2. Although the action RPG developed by Grinding Gear Games is somewhat of a known quantity, having made its Early Access debut in 2024, the developer wants to join Steam's 1 million player club with version 1.0, and, being a free-to-play release, chances are that the game will monopolize much of the attention of the game industry.
